title: [finding] an undeclared `number` field prints two different decimal widths on two faces of the same column — and ⛔ `number ⇒ 0` cannot be the fix, because a declared 0 also turns grouping OFF
body:
Filed at 2026-09-22T02:11Z by the `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01AmH9bKvGoLjiY86Q4Z3og2`, seat post #18917), from the
`out_of_scope_findings` of the #19579 round, marked **class (a)** by the dev. ⛔ Filed unassigned, ⛔ no
`priority:*`, ⛔ no type — routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Not a ruling.

⭐ **This card exists because a ruling said it must.** Ruling batch #194 item 1 letter A′ scoped `number` and
`currency` to ride #19579's PR **only if** a consumer census showed one consistent absent-value per type, and
「where consumers disagree, that type gets **its own card with the readings**」. The `number` census came back
**inconsistent**. ⇒ this is that card, with those readings.

## The defect

An **undeclared** `number` field — no `scale` on the declaration — prints a **different number of decimal
places** in its own cell than in the summary footer under that same column. One field, one value, two widths,
from a single empty declaration.

## ⏱️ Readings — the sibling repo `objectstack-ai/objectui`

⚠️ **Provenance split, stated rather than blurred.** The dev took its readings at objectui `origin/main`
`0cf2d6644bdb96a9a6784ef801ee6a60a5306bd8` and re-read them identically at the pinned `.objectui-sha`
`87af769e9a3ee28ace099fdd653d3ebd79fe82e2`. **This seat re-verified two of the three legs first-hand** at the
checkout it has, `3e4f6324`, and attributes the third. Line numbers move between shas; the facts are what to
carry.

| leg | reading | who took it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the summary footer resolves absence to **0** | `packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts:343` — `const decimals = column?.scale ?? 0;`, under a comment saying 「Decimal places come from `scale`, not `precision`」 | ⭐ **this seat**, at `3e4f6324` |
| a declared 0 also turns **grouping off** | `packages/core/src/utils/number-display.ts:150` declares `shouldGroupDisplayNumber(scale?, currency?)` and `:197` consumes it as `if (!shouldGroupDisplayNumber(...)) intlOptions.useGrouping = false` | ⭐ **this seat**, at `3e4f6324` |
| the cell resolves absence to **no fixed width** (`minimumFractionDigits 0` / `maximumFractionDigits 20`) | `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` — the dev cites `:772-773` at its own shas; at `3e4f6324` this file's `maximumFractionDigits` hits sit at `:500`, `:518`, `:530`, `:555`, so the **line** is sha-dependent | ⛔ **the dev's**, ⛔ not re-taken here |
| ⭐ dark control, same instrument, same corpus | `zzzNotAFunction` → exit **1**, 0 hits | this seat |

Two further sites the dev names as resolving absence to 0, ⛔ not re-taken by this seat:
`packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts:401` and
`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:229`.

## ⭐⭐ Why `number ⇒ 0` is NOT the fix — this is the whole reason the card exists

`percent ⇒ 0` worked because a percent's declared scale is its decimal width and nothing else. For `number`
the same value carries a **second** meaning:

> `shouldGroupDisplayNumber(scale) => scale !== 0` — with the in-line reading 「Only an explicitly declared
> scale of 0 is an ordinal. `undefined !== 0`」

⇒ a **declared** 0 marks the field as an **ordinal** (a year, a fiscal period, an identifier) and renders it
**ungrouped**, while an **absent** scale keeps its separators. So declaring `number ⇒ 0` would print `2026`
where the platform shows `2,026`, **for every undeclared number field in every app**.

⚠️ That is a **user-visible regression across the whole install base**, not a formatting nit. It is also why
the ruling refused plain letter A.

## What the decision actually is

Not 「what is `number`'s default scale」 but: **can one declaration serve both the display width and the
ordinal marker, or does the ordinal marker need its own key?** ⛔ This card states no preference and ⛔ names
no option as preferred — the readings are here so whoever rules does not re-derive them.

## Seam

`spec:FieldSchema.scale` → `renderer:NumberCellRenderer` | `renderer:useColumnSummary` |
`renderer:ObjectMetricWidget` | `core:shouldGroupDisplayNumber`

## Why it lands in THIS repo

The ruling puts the declaration in `packages/spec`; the consumer half follows in objectui
(`objectstack-ai/objectui#9843` holds that half). 〈多仓协调〉rule 1: 「issue 住在修复落地的仓」.

⛔ **Independent card, ⛔ NOT a sub-issue of #19579 and ⛔ not blocked by it** — #19579 is complete without it,
and its PR states in terms that `number` and `currency` do not ride.

## Dedupe

`absent scale number default` · `number-display grouping scale 0` · `NumberCellRenderer maximumFractionDigits 20` ·
`useColumnSummary decimals` · `shouldGroupDisplayNumber ordinal` · `declared zero turns grouping off`
